title: The Trail of Cape Reckoning
author: H. M. Voss
blurb: Xanthe Okafor, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
